description: Spark-X2.5 (local, llama.cpp) - Run Claude Code against a local Spark-X2.5 GGUF through the Anthropic-compatible API of llama.cpp's llama-server, with no API key or cloud account. Start the server first: llama-server -m Spark-X2.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf --jinja -c 65536 --alias spark-x2.5 --port 8080 (llama.cpp b10828 or later). Claude Code's system prompt alone is about 18K tokens, so keep the context at 64K or more. The Ollama build of Spark-X2.5 does not advertise tool calling and cannot drive Claude Code; use llama.cpp. Weights: https://huggingface.co/XHToken/Spark-X2.5-4B-GGUF
